retirement_age.notes: Under Social Insurance Law 148 of 2019 the normal pension age is 60. From 1 July 2032 it rises to 61 and then by one year every two years, reaching 65 by 2040. One law firm summary states 65 for employers and business owners.

political_system: republic with an executive president and a prime minister appointed by the president
